question: Can the official phased panel provide population- and recent-kinship-disjoint source blocks with rare-allele support outside the NatWGS-128 ascertainment panel?

ibd_contract.threshold_source: IBD_relatedness relatedness_v1.py uses total IBD divided by four genome lengths for kinship and names 0 or 10 cM as typical max-segment filters; pedigree expectations define the three kinship thresholds.
ibd_contract.primary_block_policy: max_segment_cm>=10 and kinship>=0.04419417382415922, unioned with exact Ancestry x canonical Population strata; Source is retained as batch provenance but cannot split the same biological population

gates.name: input_and_provenance_contract
gates.pass_rule: Exactly 22 autosomes have matching Refined-IBD files, logs and genetic maps; every log reports the frozen version, 3,685 samples, length=2 and LOD=3; every segment has nine valid fields and satisfies those floors.

gates.name: identity_and_population_coverage_contract
gates.pass_rule: The phased panel, resolved-strata table and IBD universe contain the same 3,685 unique identifiers; all 128 NatWGS discovery samples are population-interpretable Native-American samples; 3,675 panel samples have population metadata and the 10 documented unmatched samples are retained for identity and IBD accounting but excluded from ancestry-specific interpretation.

gates.name: rare_bridge_reproduction
gates.pass_rule: The frozen M27B definition reproduces exactly 954 direct phase-bridge sites; their sorted private key-plus-orientation list receives a SHA-256 digest but is not published.

gates.name: three_role_block_feasibility
gates.pass_rule: Under the primary recent-kinship policy, AFR, EUR and NAM each retain at least three canonical-Population x kinship blocks; raw >=2 cM connected components are reported only as a percolation diagnostic and are not interpreted as pedigrees.

gates.name: external_native_american_rare_support
gates.pass_rule: At least one of the 954 frozen alleles is carried in at least two discovery blocks and at least two external-role-eligible Native-American blocks under the primary policy. An external block is eligible only if neither that block nor its canonical Population contains a NatWGS discovery sample. This proves structural transfer only, not adequate power.

gates.name: baseline_overlap_audit
gates.pass_rule: Exact-key and same-position overlap between the 954 keys and the frozen Gnomix baseline are measured with explicit contingency invariants. This is diagnostic; a future compatible baseline must exclude every target rare position from its common channel.

gates.name: external_population_concentration
gates.pass_rule: At least one primary transferable Native-American site still has two external role-eligible blocks after removing each carrier canonical Population stratum in turn. Blocks and canonical Populations that also contain NatWGS discovery samples are never external-role eligible. This is a concentration diagnostic, not a claim of biological replication.

stop_rules: Never use a raw any-segment >=2 cM connected component as a pedigree certificate.
Never place NatWGS-128 discovery samples in SOURCE_VALID or SOURCE_TEST for this frozen 954-site list.
Never choose a kinship or segment threshold after observing rare-site support.
Never orient or select rare alleles using SOURCE_VALID or SOURCE_TEST.
Never treat sites, segments, individuals or demes as independent replicates.
Do not simulate, run LAI, train a model, inspect a future SOURCE_TEST genotype partition or execute KING in M27E.
If E4 fails under the primary policy, do not rescue it by selecting a diagnostic sensitivity.
If a future common baseline contains any target rare key, exclude it or preregister a separate shared-marker ablation before comparing incremental value.

amendments.reason: The frozen M27D strata artifact resolves all 3,685 panel identities but documents population metadata for 3,675; ten samples are unmatched. Requiring invented population labels would violate the fail-closed identity policy.
amendments.delta: Use the hash-pinned M27D resolved-strata artifact; keep all samples in identity/IBD accounting and exclude only the ten documented unmatched samples from ancestry-specific summaries. No IBD, rare-allele or gate threshold changed.

amendments.reason: The first complete M27E output reported 237 transferable Native-American sites and 507 baseline overlaps separately, which cannot establish whether any transferable site is actually absent from the baseline or robust to one external population dominating support.
amendments.delta: Add exact joint counts for transferability x baseline overlap, require phased external heterozygous carriers, merge identical biological populations across data sources, and add anonymized leave-one-external-population-out and effective-concentration summaries. Thresholds, variant selection, allele orientation, IBD calls and input files remain frozen.

amendments.reason: The second PRE review found that an IBD block or canonical Population containing both NatWGS discovery and external samples could be counted on both sides, and that exact-key absence from the unusable frozen baseline is not the separation rule for the future redesigned baseline.
amendments.delta: Define external-role-eligible carriers by excluding every external sample whose IBD block or canonical Population contains any discovery sample; use only the remaining blocks for transferability, leave-one-population-out and concentration. Keep exact-key and same-position baseline overlap as an audited diagnostic, but require the future common baseline to exclude all 954 target positions. Sites, orientation, IBD calls, thresholds and inputs remain frozen.

amendments.reason: The POST review found that passing structural transferability does not yet authorize redesigning or training a baseline. A single joint role assignment, spatial concentration and an identifiable power design remain unverified.
amendments.delta: Narrow the positive decision label from GO_BASELINE_REDESIGN_AND_POWER_ONLY to GO_POWER_DESIGN_ONLY. No data, site, allele orientation, IBD definition, threshold, gate or numerical result changed.
